notes.title: Pokémon dialogue — League Circuit
notes.text: Pokémon-only square League Circuit nameplates, dialogue and narration in main chat. Compact mobile headers show actual HP, level, gender and current owner. Display nicknames first, otherwise Pokédex names. Artwork/Sprite and animation follow the existing character settings. Stable individual speaker IDs separate identical species and Trainers from wild Pokémon; no Pokémon NPC dossiers are created. Uses the selected RoleForge theme fonts and its independent Header/Dialogue/Narrative switches. Works with shared Regex presentation and follows swipe/delete/reload state.
